messages:
Anna: Quick heads-up — planning a runtime push tonight at 23:00 UTC. It includes kernel batching + cache changes that touch runtime and console routes. Need coordinated pin and rollback gating for API/runtime/console/router. Who can own router pin? @mike?
Mike: I'm around. Router team prefers pin-first then traffic-slice canary. What's the target pin version for API?
Anna: API will be v2.9.3 (minor schema compat). Runtime v3.2.1. Console v1.8.0-rc2. Router v1.4.5. Plan: canary 10% for 20m, telemetry checks, then 50% then full if green.
Lina: I'll take release notes, pls drop changelog link. Also confirm rollout note for customers (Dedicated) re: brief degraded throughput.
deploy-bot: preflight checks started: image scan ok, infra gates ok, canary targets set -> 10% on region us-east1. (CI: #4821)
Ethan: SRE: define rollback gating thresholds: p95 latency increase > 30% OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained 5m => instant rollback. Also watch KV-eviction rate and GPU OOMs.
Mike: Router pin: we'll pin route to v1.4.5 and enable header-swap. Canary slice: header X-Canary: runtime-v3.2.1
Anna: Good. Also add automatic fallback to runtime v3.1.9 if canary fails. Rollback command (ops):
```
# rollback runtime canary
./orch rollback runtime --service runtime --to v3.1.9 --reason "canary gating"
```
Lina: Release notes draft: short bullets + link to console UI change. I'll post doc in #release-notes in 30m.
Ethan: I'll set SLO guardrails in deploybot: latency/p95 300ms, error rate 0.2% for canary window. If triggered, deploy-bot will pause and alert oncall.
deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-03-23T23:00:00Z -> 10% us-east1. Monitoring hooks: runtime, router, api, console. Logs streamed to /deploys/6512343210.
Anna: Thanks. After 20m if green we rotate to 50%. If any service shows regressions, we abort and run rollback command above. @mike @ethan ack?
Mike: ack
Ethan: ack, watching metrics and postmortem hooks.
Lina: ack — release notes will include rollback steps & customer impact.
Anna: tagging @support to prep customer comms if needed :email:
support: on it, will draft email and standby.
deploy-bot: canary update: +1 failure in console backend (timeouts) — error-rate 0.08% -> below threshold but investigating. @Anna @Ethan
Ethan: seeing increased tail in console db calls, throttling spike. Rolling back console canary only to v1.7.9 to isolate.
Mike: Router will keep pinned for API/runtime, excluding console route. Adjusting traffic slice to remove console canary.
deploy-bot: console canary rollback executed -> console -> v1.7.9. Canary adjusted. Canary now 10% for runtime+api only.
Anna: Good catch. Keep the rest moving. Update release notes line about console hotfix.
Lina: done, pushed notes: https://docs.internal/rn/6512343210
support: drafted customer note, queued for review.
Anna: final: post-rollback review sprint tomorrow morning. Thanks team :thumbsup:
